final: SELECT AVG(avg_price_to_total), AVG(matched_lines) FROM (SELECT oi.order_item_id, AVG(1.0 * ili.product_price / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS avg_price_to_total, COUNT(ili.order_item_id) AS matched_lines FROM Order_Items AS oi LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items AS ili ON ili.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id GROUP BY oi.order_item_id)
